reason: Two big customers cut orders last quarter, so I need new buyers and my network is tapped out. The free list of 15 companies and paying the second half only after 5 real meetings means I am not just handing over money like I did with the last agency.
objection: I paid an agency before and got nothing but reports. My worry is the 15 companies will be names I already know or junk, and that the meetings will be people who take a call and never buy.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15-company sample is mostly companies I already know or that are obviously wrong for us, or the past client they connect me to does not confirm the meetings turned into real business, I walk away.
